verdict.rationale: AutoGen's docs list a first-party Logging feature to 'log traces and internal messages,' which covers the tracing core of the story. Nothing shows those traces surfacing in an observability UI, or that every LLM call and tool invocation is captured. AutoGen Studio is described only as an environment for testing and running teams, not as a trace viewer. Missing for 10: an observability UI for viewing traces, documented per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation spans, export to tracing backends, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: Logging: Log traces and internal messages
